answer.what_it_does: SRF Limited is a chemical-based, multi-business conglomerate engaged in manufacturing industrial and specialty intermediates. Its operations encompass technical textiles, chemicals, performance films, foils, and other allied products.

facts.fact: The Company operates 16 manufacturing facilities – 13 in India and one each in Thailand, South Africa, and Hungary.

answer.geography: Commercial interests in over 90 countries worldwide.
answer.revenue_mix_basis: External sales in Crores for the year ended March 31, 2026

risks.risk: Strategic risks arising out of macro-economics and external conditions.
Operational risks from inadequate manufacturing processes or technological disruptions.
Regulatory risks from non-compliances due to changes in laws.
IT and Cyber risks regarding non-availability of technical infrastructure and data security.
